executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort, not a vague visibility problem.

What the Data Is Telling Us. The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort appears in 2 monitored scenarios where Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Adults-Only at 24.7% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers. Softest coverage today is Leisure Travel at 63.6% Scenario Capture. When absent, The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort appears most often (2 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Leisure Travel is the softest Scenario Capture at 63.6%, while Business Travel show broader coverage. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort appears most often when the hotel is missing (2 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 28.6% (2 of 7 attributes).

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on the demand contexts where The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort is consistently surfaced instead of Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Open the underlying displacement evidence for The St. Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort and compare attributes cited in those answers with Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
